tagline: Monster's 25 health is the fuel: spend it to move him, draw, heal, and swing for 8

featuredCards.title: mad, they call me!
featuredCards.caption: The setup. Monster only moves 1 on his own, so this drags him up to 6 spaces at once, and every 2 spaces adds +1 to the swing. The discards are the price.

featuredCards.title: tragic bond
featuredCards.caption: The engine. Monster's health is a bank: hurt him for up to 3, then cash it in as a heal for Frankestein or three fresh cards.

featuredCards.title: unnatural strength
featuredCards.caption: The payoff. An 8 that loses 1 for every Frankestein card it makes you discard and every one already in your discard pile. Bottom-deck them with the ability to keep the pile clean.

featuredCards.title: blind rage
featuredCards.caption: The twist, four copies deep. Nothing can cancel it, and if the two stand side by side the attack lands on the other fighter and the value is 6.
